title: Organization and optimization
brief: Separate query organization from assumptions about optimization.
instructions: Return the same paid UTC 2024 monthly revenue as the staged order/month report. Both inline and MATERIALIZED CTE forms are valid; no speedup or optimizer shape is required.

A paid order is an order whose own status is 'paid'; the payments table carries a separate status that these challenges never ask about. For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: The starter exposes orders. Two complete equivalent forms follow. Inline form: WITH paid AS (SELECT o.order_id,date_trunc('month',o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::DATE AS mon FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'),order_revenue AS (SELECT p.order_id,p.mon,coalesce(sum(i.qty::DECIMAL(18,0)*i.unit_price)::DECIMAL(38,2),0)::DECIMAL(38,2) AS revenue FROM paid p LEFT JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) GROUP BY p.order_id,p.mon) SELECT mon,sum(revenue)::DECIMAL(38,2) AS revenue FROM order_revenue GROUP BY mon ORDER BY mon; Materialized form: WITH paid AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT o.order_id,date_trunc('month',o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::DATE AS mon FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'),order_revenue AS (SELECT p.order_id,p.mon,coalesce(sum(i.qty::DECIMAL(18,0)*i.unit_price)::DECIMAL(38,2),0)::DECIMAL(38,2) AS revenue FROM paid p LEFT JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) GROUP BY p.order_id,p.mon) SELECT mon,sum(revenue)::DECIMAL(38,2) AS revenue FROM order_revenue GROUP BY mon ORDER BY mon; Completion depends on the result, not which form runs faster.

hints.text: CTEs organize queries; materialization is not a guaranteed performance improvement.
Compare WITH paid AS (...) and WITH paid AS MATERIALIZED (...) around the same population.
Changing organization must not remove zero-revenue paid activity.
